description: Main source file for a Bluetooth TMAP peripheral implementation using Zephyr RTOS, handling Bluetooth connections, advertising, TMAP discovery, and media control.

methods.name: tmap_discovery_complete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon TMAP discovery completion, updates peer role flags.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth connection event, references connection and signals connection semaphore.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth disconnection event, unreferences connection and signals disconnection semaphore.

methods.name: security_changed
methods.description: Handles security level change events, signals security update semaphore.

methods.name: adv_rpa_expired_cb
methods.description: Callback for RPA expiration, regenerates RSI and updates advertising data.

methods.name: audio_timer_timeout
methods.description: Timer callback to terminate a call.

methods.name: media_play_timeout
methods.description: Timer callback to send media pause command.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth, advertising, TMAP, media, and handling call/media control logic.
